defect: a destination qualifier is combined with an asynchronous valid signal before synchronization
rationale: valid_a is asynchronous to clk_b and is combined with ready_b before entering the receiving pipeline, so the qualifier is part of the unsynchronized crossing.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Combinational AND of valid_a with ready_b feeds the first synchroniser flop, so glitches on the crossing signal can be sampled.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the receiver-side valid/ready context and two-register destination sampling, reduced the handshake implementation, and exposed a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Moved the ready_b qualification into the expression sampled by the first destination stage alongside valid_a.
